metadata.source: https://www.adobe.com/about-adobe/contact/offices.html (fallback knowledge when fetch fails with HTTP2 INTERNAL_ERROR) — Adobe HQ San Jose 345 Park Ave, SF 601 Townsend, Seattle 8005 34th Ave S, Lehi UT, NYC, Austin etc. Nearest no-retailer spot chosen per office.
metadata.purpose: Show workers what their local Costco shoppers see vs what frontier folks see, elevate frontiersfolks who make breakfast yummy while staying right for fitness lifestyle

mappings.retailer_gap: Arcangeli Grocery only; nearest Costco 30mi (South SF). Winding Hwy 1 / 84.
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Castroville artichokes (peak Mar–Jun, April centerfold) + Marin County goat cheese (fresh chèvre Feb–Jun, peak spring) — Pescadero winter-to-summer
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® × Pescadero — artichoke + Marin chèvre savory flapjacks. 35mi from your office, still farms your breakfast. Half Moon Bay near.
mappings.ad_example_visual: Artichoke field at dawn, Harley Farms goat dairy, Kodiak box with artichoke hearts + chèvre on wood board, Hwy 1 fog
mappings.fitness_angle: Urban SF workers see Pescadero frontier to understand hinterland — protein that stays lean for Half Moon Bay trail, not heavy brunch. Elevate the Pescadero farmers who keep the Bay fed.
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Costco South SF / Redwood City bulk families see 'Stock the frontier — every morning' with big griddle; Pescadero sees subscription & Amazon.com small-batch artichoke + chèvre

mappings.retailer_gap: Same as above — 35mi, one farm road, no chain grocer
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Same artichoke + Marin goat cheese — spring workforce helps SF see frontier around them
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Pescadero frontier — Castroville artichokes meet Marin chèvre, 14g protein, Half Moon Bay near
mappings.fitness_angle: Help urban folks see representation of the frontier around them — SF fitness is trail, not brunch
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: SF Costco shoppers see 30-bulk, Pescadero sees farm-stand direct

mappings.retailer_gap: Only Washburn's General Store; true grocer Port Angeles 70mi winding two-lane; 4-5hr to Seattle incl ferry
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Makah salmon May–Sep, halibut Mar–Jun, huckleberries Aug — Washington water + Washington grain
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Neah Bay frontier — huckleberry compote over Buttermilk Power Cakes, Makah water meets Wasatch grain. Where Washburn's has the dusty box, we ship.
mappings.ad_example_visual: Neah Bay harbor, Makah cedar canoe, Kodiak box on Washburn's porch, 70mi sign to Port Angeles
mappings.fitness_angle: Seattle rain-morning bulk vs Neah Bay trail/harbor — same Washington state, different frontier. Subscription & amazon.com ads seen alongside Seattle if Washington noted on app open — ask use your location or choose from list.
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Seattle Costco (home) bulk families see 'Evergreen frontier — protein-packed whole grains for gray mornings'; Neah Bay sees subscription huckleberry + smoked salmon savory, elevating Makah frontiersfolks

mappings.retailer_gap: Target Kimball Junction is nearby but Loa 84747 / Pescadero analogues are farther; Park City Farmers Market Wed 11-5 is local frontier flavor
mappings.seasonal_flavor: Jensen Farms peaches diced thin + cinnamon, Copper Moose rhubarb compote orange juice, Tagges preserves, Ballerina butter Kamas — Utah summer
mappings.ad_example_message: KODIAK® Park City 84098 — Keep It Wild from Farmers Market at base of Park City Mountain Resort. Jensen Farms peaches + Ballerina butter.
mappings.fitness_angle: Lehi tech + Park City trail — Wasatch fitness is ski before work, trail after
mappings.what_costco_shoppers_see: Lehi Costco shoppers see Utah bulk; Park City sees market-direct peach + butter
